violations_found.violations:
- Modelling choice violated (Constraint 5): The EU introduces a new measure, "Accelerate EU AI Safety Assurance Infrastructure", while also naming it as the priority in the same turn. This constitutes both introducing a new measure and explicitly naming a priority, violating the rule that "at most one new measure per turn, and at most one named priority" is allowed. The notepad confirms this by listing the measure with a priority penalty ("priority −1"), indicating it is both introduced and prioritized in the same turn.
- Regulatory Constraint violated (Constraint 6): The new measure is described as being launched with emergency powers and already mandating direct access to model weights and training data. This implies immediate implementation of a high-cost, high-complexity regulatory regime. However, Constraint 6 states: "No measure is implemented instantly. Minimum time from proposal to full effect is one full turn for low-cost measures and two for high-cost ones..." Given the scale and enforcement demands (cross-border data access, real-time monitoring, red-team integration), this is clearly a high-cost measure, yet it is portrayed as operational immediately upon proposal, violating minimum lead time requirements.
